example.name: complete_install_script
example.description: A complete, production-ready installation script template that demonstrates all best practices: idempotency, cross-platform support, security, and logging.
example.context: Use as a starting point for any installation script
example.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash # install.sh - Dotfiles installation script # This script is idempotent and can be run multiple times safely. # # Usage: # ./install.sh # Normal installation # DEBUG=1 ./install.sh # With debug logging # DRY_RUN=1 ./install.sh # Preview changes without making them
set -euo pipefail
# =========================================================================== # Configuration # ===========================================================================
readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)" readonly DOTFILES_DIR="${SCRIPT_DIR}" readonly BACKUP_DIR="${HOME}/.dotfiles_backup/$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
# Feature flags (can be set via environment) readonly DRY_RUN="${DRY_RUN:-false}" readonly DEBUG="${DEBUG:-0}" readonly SKIP_HOMEBREW="${DOTFILES_SKIP_HOMEBREW:-false}" readonly SKIP_SYMLINKS="${DOTFILES_SKIP_SYMLINKS:-false}"
# =========================================================================== # Logging # ===========================================================================
setup_colors() { if [[ -t 1 ]] && [[ "${TERM:-dumb}" != "dumb" ]]; then RED='\033[0;31m' GREEN='\033[0;32m' YELLOW='\033[1;33m' BLUE='\033[0;34m' PURPLE='\033[0;35m' NC='\033[0m' else RED='' GREEN='' YELLOW='' BLUE='' PURPLE='' NC='' fi }
log_info() { echo -e "${BLUE}ℹ${NC} $*"; } log_success() { echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} $*"; } log_warning() { echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠${NC} $*" >&2; } log_error() { echo -e "${RED}✗${NC} $*" >&2; } log_step() { echo -e "${PURPLE}→${NC} $*"; } log_debug() { [[ "$DEBUG" == "1" ]] && echo -e "[DEBUG] $*" >&2 || true; }
setup_colors
# =========================================================================== # Platform Detection # ===========================================================================
detect_os() { case "$(uname -s)" in Linux*) echo "linux" ;; Darwin*) echo "macos" ;; MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) echo "windows" ;; *) echo "unknown" ;; esac }
detect_environment() { local os os=$(detect_os)
if [[ "$os" == "linux" ]]; then if [[ -f /.dockerenv ]] || [[ -f /run/.containerenv ]]; then echo "container" elif grep -qi microsoft /proc/version 2>/dev/null; then echo "wsl" else echo "native" fi else echo "native" fi }
readonly OS=$(detect_os) readonly ENV=$(detect_environment)
log_info "Platform: $OS ($ENV)"
# =========================================================================== # Utility Functions # ===========================================================================
# Execute command (or show in dry-run mode) run() { if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then log_info "[DRY RUN] $*" else log_debug "Running: $*" "$@" fi }
# Create symlink idempotently create_symlink() { local source="$1" local target="$2"
# Validate source exists if [[ ! -e "$source" ]]; then log_error "Source does not exist: $source" return 1 fi
# Already correct? if [[ -L "$target" ]] && [[ "$(readlink "$target")" == "$source" ]]; then log_info "Already linked: $target" return 0 fi
# Create parent directory run mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
# Backup existing file if [[ -e "$target" ]] && [[ ! -L "$target" ]]; then run mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR" run mv "$target" "$BACKUP_DIR/" log_warning "Backed up: $target → $BACKUP_DIR/" fi
# Remove existing symlink [[ -L "$target" ]] && run rm "$target"
# Create new symlink run ln -s "$source" "$target" log_success "Linked: $target → $source" }
# Check if command exists has_command() { command -v "$1" &>/dev/null }
# =========================================================================== # Installation Functions # ===========================================================================
install_homebrew() { if [[ "$SKIP_HOMEBREW" == "true" ]]; then log_info "Skipping Homebrew (DOTFILES_SKIP_HOMEBREW=true)" return 0 fi
if has_command brew; then log_info "Homebrew already installed" return 0 fi
log_step "Installing Homebrew..."
case "$OS" in macos|linux) if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then log_info "[DRY RUN] Would install Homebrew" else /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)" fi ;; windows) log_warning "Homebrew not supported on Windows/Git Bash" return 0 ;; esac
log_success "Homebrew installed" }
install_packages() { if ! has_command brew; then log_warning "Homebrew not available, skipping packages" return 0 fi
local packages=( "ripgrep" "fd" "bat" "eza" "fzf" "jq" "yq" )
log_step "Installing packages..."
for pkg in "${packages[@]}"; do if brew list "$pkg" &>/dev/null; then log_info "$pkg already installed" else run brew install "$pkg" log_success "Installed $pkg" fi done }
setup_symlinks() { if [[ "$SKIP_SYMLINKS" == "true" ]]; then log_info "Skipping symlinks (DOTFILES_SKIP_SYMLINKS=true)" return 0 fi
log_step "Setting up symlinks..."
# Shell configuration create_symlink "$DOTFILES_DIR/shell/bashrc" "$HOME/.bashrc" create_symlink "$DOTFILES_DIR/shell/zshrc" "$HOME/.zshrc" create_symlink "$DOTFILES_DIR/shell/profile" "$HOME/.profile"
# Git configuration create_symlink "$DOTFILES_DIR/git/gitconfig" "$HOME/.gitconfig" create_symlink "$DOTFILES_DIR/git/gitignore_global" "$HOME/.gitignore_global"
# Editor configuration if [[ "$ENV" == "container" ]]; then local vscode_dir="$HOME/.vscode-server/data/User" elif [[ "$OS" == "macos" ]]; then local vscode_dir="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Code/User" else local vscode_dir="$HOME/.config/Code/User" fi
create_symlink "$DOTFILES_DIR/vscode/settings.json" "$vscode_dir/settings.json" create_symlink "$DOTFILES_DIR/vscode/keybindings.json" "$vscode_dir/keybindings.json" }
# =========================================================================== # Main # ===========================================================================
main() { echo log_info "╔════════════════════════════════════╗" log_info "║ Dotfiles Installation Script ║" log_info "╚════════════════════════════════════╝" echo
if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then log_warning "DRY RUN MODE - No changes will be made" echo fi
install_homebrew install_packages setup_symlinks
echo log_success "Installation complete!"
if [[ -d "$BACKUP_DIR" ]]; then log_info "Backups saved to: $BACKUP_DIR" fi }
main "$@"

example.name: devcontainer_setup
example.description: DevContainer post-create setup script demonstrating secure tool installation and environment configuration.
example.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash # devcontainer-setup.sh - DevContainer initialization script # Runs as postCreateCommand when container is first created
set -euo pipefail
# =========================================================================== # Configuration # ===========================================================================
# These can be overridden via devcontainer.json containerEnv readonly DOTFILES_REPO="${DEVMAGIC_DOTFILES_REPO:-}" readonly DOTFILES_BRANCH="${DEVMAGIC_DOTFILES_BRANCH:-main}" readonly DOTFILES_DIR="${HOME}/prj/dotfiles"
# =========================================================================== # Logging (simplified for container output) # ===========================================================================
log() { echo "→ $*"; } log_success() { echo "✓ $*"; } log_warning() { echo "⚠ $*" >&2; } log_error() { echo "✗ $*" >&2; }
# =========================================================================== # Functions # ===========================================================================
setup_dotfiles() { # Skip if no repo configured if [[ -z "$DOTFILES_REPO" ]]; then log "No dotfiles repo configured (set DEVMAGIC_DOTFILES_REPO)" return 0 fi
log "Setting up dotfiles from $DOTFILES_REPO..."
# Clone if not exists if [[ ! -d "$DOTFILES_DIR" ]]; then mkdir -p "$(dirname "$DOTFILES_DIR")" git clone --depth=1 --branch "$DOTFILES_BRANCH" "$DOTFILES_REPO" "$DOTFILES_DIR" log_success "Cloned dotfiles" else log "Dotfiles already exist at $DOTFILES_DIR" fi
# Run install script if available local install_script="$DOTFILES_DIR/shell/install.sh" if [[ -f "$install_script" ]]; then log "Running dotfiles install script..." bash "$install_script" || log_warning "Dotfiles install had warnings" fi }
setup_shell_history() { # Create persistent history file location local history_dir="${HOME}/.local/share/shell" mkdir -p "$history_dir"
# Bash history if [[ ! -f "$history_dir/bash_history" ]]; then touch "$history_dir/bash_history" fi
# Zsh history if [[ ! -f "$history_dir/zsh_history" ]]; then touch "$history_dir/zsh_history" fi
log_success "Shell history configured" }
install_ai_tools() { log "Installing AI CLI tools..."
local npm_packages=( "@anthropic-ai/claude-code" "@google/gemini-cli" )
# Install via pnpm if available if command -v pnpm &>/dev/null; then for pkg in "${npm_packages[@]}"; do log "Installing $pkg..." pnpm add -g "$pkg" 2>/dev/null || log_warning "Failed to install $pkg" done else log_warning "pnpm not available, skipping NPM packages" fi
log_success "AI tools setup complete" }
# =========================================================================== # Main # ===========================================================================
main() { echo echo "╔═══════════════════════════════════════╗" echo "║ DevContainer Setup ║" echo "╚═══════════════════════════════════════╝" echo
setup_dotfiles setup_shell_history install_ai_tools
echo log_success "Container setup complete!" }
main "$@"

example.name: homebrew_bundle
example.description: Homebrew Brewfile with platform-specific packages and taps.
example.code:
# Brewfile - Homebrew bundle for cross-platform development # Usage: brew bundle --file=Brewfile
# Taps tap "homebrew/bundle" tap "homebrew/cask" if OS.mac?
# =========================================================================== # Core CLI Tools (all platforms) # ===========================================================================
# Modern replacements brew "bat" # Better cat brew "eza" # Better ls brew "fd" # Better find brew "ripgrep" # Better grep brew "sd" # Better sed brew "dust" # Better du brew "duf" # Better df brew "procs" # Better ps brew "bottom" # Better top
# Essential tools brew "fzf" # Fuzzy finder brew "jq" # JSON processor brew "yq" # YAML processor brew "git" # Version control brew "gh" # GitHub CLI brew "tmux" # Terminal multiplexer brew "zoxide" # Smart cd
# Development brew "shellcheck" # Shell script linter brew "shfmt" # Shell formatter
# =========================================================================== # Platform-Specific # ===========================================================================
if OS.mac? # macOS-only tools brew "coreutils" # GNU core utilities brew "gnu-sed" # GNU sed
# Casks (macOS GUI apps) cask "visual-studio-code" cask "iterm2" cask "rectangle" # Window management cask "1password-cli" end
if OS.linux? # Linux-specific (usually already have GNU tools) brew "xclip" unless ENV["WSL_DISTRO_NAME"] end
# =========================================================================== # Optional (uncomment as needed) # ===========================================================================
# brew "hugo" # Static site generator # brew "babashka" # Clojure scripting # brew "deno" # JavaScript runtime # brew "go" # Go language
